long_description_md:
## What it does

`aeon-skill-pack-liquidpad` gives an Aeon agent read-only visibility into the LiquidPad token-launch protocol on Base. It bundles four scheduled skills that track $LPAD burn cycles, new token launches, protocol-wide stats, and claimable trading fees.

## Skills

- **liquidpad-burn-monitor** — Tracks $LPAD buyback & burn cycles and alerts when a new cycle ships.
- **liquidpad-stats-digest** — Daily LiquidPad protocol digest: tokens deployed, momentum, and top tokens by 24h volume.
- **liquidpad-token-alert** — Notifies when a new token launches through LiquidPad and verifies on-chain provenance via `/api/verify`.
- **liquidpad-fee-tracker** — Tracks claimable trading fees on every LiquidPad-launched token and surfaces the top earners.

## Details

- Homepage: https://www.liquidpad.site
- License: MIT
- Each skill ships a scheduled cron default and is disabled by default until enabled.
